name: manual_fee930
claim: After any uncertain GitHub Contents API write, read the target ref and compare the expected blob before retrying; a new commit SHA or successful transport response is not proof of insertion, and a retry after delayed success can create an empty child commit with the same tree as its parent.

decisions.notes: Periscope PR #49 provides exact proof: 214b0c03 changed one test file with 45 insertions and produced tree bd81bba7; child faf515e4 repeated the subject but had the identical bd81bba7 tree and zero file delta after a blind retry. This extends existing empty-commit lesson lesson_9fac191b11e1 from automation-authored/no-op commits to API timeout and retry semantics.
